schedule.trip_association_method: Sort 63 route trips by unique MPL4 times. Independently verify identical unique ordering at ARSM2 and 0BLRB and exact equality with per-stop anchor responses. For each intermediate stop, construct a 63-by-63 bipartite graph: an arrival may map to a trip only if it lies between the trip adjacent ARSM2/MPL4 or MPL4/0BLRB timing points. Rank join is a complete valid matching. Independently delete each of its 63 edges and recompute maximum matching; every deletion lowers the maximum from 63 to 62, proving it is the only perfect matching. All joined trip stop times strictly increase. No trip-order assumption is needed for that uniqueness proof.
schedule.calendar_caveat: services API selected_date20261028 resolves active service. Nested route service_days all false and dates null; do not interpret as no service. Current full calendar_dates export not verified.
schedule.intermediate_timepoint_caveat: Designated timing points in this Porto section: MPL4, 0BLRB. Other published stop seconds are intermediate references; none is an observed passage.
schedule.trip_association_limit: Some upstream arrivals individually fit two anchor windows, but global one-to-one matching resolves them uniquely. Proof assumes each of the 63 published stop arrivals belongs once to the 63 route trips and occurs between the adjacent published timing points; this is validated as a coherent complete timetable, not directly exposed trip identity or observed vehicle tracking.

observations.historical_availability_status: not verified; false here means no archive obtained in this research, not proof of nonexistence
observations.stcp_vehicle_timestamp_caveat: Per-vehicle timestamp/vehicle_id null in inspected STCP API; top-level timestamp is response-generation timestamp. Broker observationDateTime and stable fleetVehicleId are preferable for collector quality checks.
observations.arrival_prediction_caveat: Stop realtime endpoint returns estimated arrivals and delay_minutes; scheduled_arrival_time is null in samples. Predictions are not actual stop passages; identical delay value at multiple stops does not localize delay.

limitations: Frozen 28 October 2026 reference, not live service.
MPL4 and 0BLRB are designated timing points; other Porto calls are intermediate published references.
Per-stop trip IDs are derived by unique matching against route timing-point anchors; source endpoint omits IDs.
No official timetable is supplied at the municipal boundary; native entry lead is assumed.
Full-line passenger/service propagation is an assumed operational model, distinct from the Porto SUMO street simulation.

municipality.method: Point-in-polygon and full ordered STCP shape intersection against raw DGT CAOP2025 municipal feature. Boundary distance and chainage measured after transforming longitude/latitude coordinates to EPSG:3763. No tolerance buffer used for classification.

municipal_entry.scheduled_time_status: No official timetable at the municipal boundary; any vehicle entry lead is a simulation assumption.

municipality.conclusion: ARS3 is the first stop strictly inside Porto, 56.37 m from the CAOP boundary. The whole municipal extent begins 59.66 m along the STCP shape before ARS3, between ARSM2 (Gondomar) and ARS3. Include that short approach; ARS3 alone does not include every metre in Porto.
municipality.limits: Classification is relative to published STCP coordinates/shape and cartographic CAOP2025, not an on-street survey; supplied source position precision is not a surveyed road-edge location.
